items.description: Recovery of stolen bicycle incl. locksmith call-out and lock cutting (3 pcs)
items.rationale: Covered under 5.2.2(a),(b),(d), but the bike is mobility equipment (4.2.2) with no scheduled value, so the EUR 500 aggregate sub-limit applies rateably. Assumed fair price approx. 450 of approx. 1,000 total indemnifiable, giving approx. 500 x 0.45 = 225.

items.description: Repair of theft damage to frame and brakes (2 pcs)
items.rationale: Repair cost under 2.3.1(b) and 7.1.1(b), within the same EUR 500 class sub-limit shared rateably. Assumed fair price approx. 400 of approx. 1,000 total, giving approx. 200.

Labour and sundries follow the covered repair and recovery work (7.1.7(d),(e), 5.2.2(b)), so indemnifiable but within the rateable sub-limit. Assumed fair price approx. 150 of approx. 1,000 total, giving approx. 75-80.
